lines.en: Zoe! Wow, you’re soaked. It’s been raining all week, hasn’t it?
lines.pt: Zoe! Nossa, você está encharcada. Tem chovido a semana toda, não é?

lines.en: All week! It’s been pouring since Monday, and my umbrella has been breaking every other day.
lines.pt: A semana toda! Chove forte desde segunda, e meu guarda-chuva tem quebrado dia sim, dia não.

lines.en: Mine too. The wind has been blowing so hard that I’ve been walking to work with my head down.
lines.pt: O meu também. O vento tem soprado tão forte que tenho andado para o trabalho de cabeça baixa.

lines.en: I’ve been taking the bus instead of cycling, and it has been running late every morning.
lines.pt: Tenho pegado o ônibus em vez de ir de bicicleta, e ele tem atrasado toda manhã.

lines.en: Typical Portland. But honestly, I’ve been enjoying the rain, because the city has been looking so green.
lines.pt: Típico de Portland. Mas, sinceramente, tenho gostado da chuva, porque a cidade tem estado tão verde.

lines.en: That’s true. The parks have been looking beautiful, and the river has been rising slowly.
lines.pt: É verdade. Os parques têm estado lindos, e o rio tem subido devagar.

lines.en: Have you been following the forecast? They say it has been the wettest week of the autumn.
lines.pt: Você tem acompanhado a previsão? Dizem que foi a semana mais chuvosa do outono.

lines.en: I have. It should clear up by Saturday, so I’ve been planning a picnic with my cousins.
lines.pt: Tenho. Deve abrir até sábado, então estou planejando um piquenique com meus primos.

lines.en: Optimistic! I’ve been staying in and baking bread, which has been making the flat smell wonderful.
lines.pt: Otimista! Eu tenho ficado em casa assando pão, o que tem deixado o apartamento com um cheiro ótimo.

lines.en: Save me a slice. I’ve been craving something warm since I got up this morning.
lines.pt: Guarde uma fatia para mim. Estou com vontade de algo quente desde que acordei.

lines.en: Come over tonight. We’ll eat bread, drink tea, and watch the rain together.
lines.pt: Venha hoje à noite. Vamos comer pão, tomar chá e ver a chuva juntas.

facts.big: It has been + -ing all week / since…
facts.label: Clima e rotina
facts.sub: Clima: It’s been raining all week. Rotina: I’ve been staying in. Duração: all week, since Monday. Pergunta: Have you been…?

facts.label: Está chovendo há…
facts.sub: Use has been + -ing para o clima que continua até agora: It’s been raining all week. It has been snowing since morning. Aqui o sujeito é it, e a duração aparece com for, since ou all + período.

facts.label: A semana toda
facts.sub: Expressões de tempo: all day, all week, all morning, all year. Elas mostram que a ação ocupa um período inteiro e combinam muito bem com have been + -ing.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “It’s been raining all week” means the rain continues until now.
A forecast tells us about the future weather.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “It’s been raining all week” means the rain continues until now. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Pouring means a little rain. → Falso (It means heavy rain.)
A forecast tells us about the future weather. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A rainy week in Portland · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a grey Friday in Portland, Oregon. The streets shine, and the trees drip with water. People hurry along under bright umbrellas. Elena stops at the corner and waves. Her friend Zoe crosses the street, completely wet. They laugh and begin to talk about the weather.

“Zoe! Wow, you’re soaked. It’s been raining all week, hasn’t it?” says Elena. “All week! It’s been pouring since Monday, and my umbrella has been breaking every other day.” says Zoe. “Mine too. The wind has been blowing so hard that I’ve been walking to work with my head down.” says Elena.
